prose: Orchestrator ask, 2026-11-12, from my seal finding (b): cairn's .gitattributes pins eol=lf for *.json, *.jsonl, *.sh and bin/cmd/* but not *.py, so a Windows checkout under core.autocrlf=true holds CRLF .py files, and the validation store's source_fingerprint hashes raw working-tree bytes with no line-ending normalisation. A Windows seal therefore cannot match the Linux one for the same commit. Measured 2026-11-12 in two fresh scratch clones on akiendell: the bce4 proof's 3-file closure fingerprints a614f1bf0b61... with the CRLF checkout and 9236ec0db64b7ad018656610854360ff20e922cc314800e238f51e09374c2612 with *.py text eol=lf, which equals the Linux value. In the index all 1,081 *.py/*.md/*.txt blobs are already LF (git ls-files --eol: 1068 i/lf w/crlf, 11 i/lf w/lf, 2 i/lf w/mixed), so renormalize is near-empty.
